about: The initial support class of every NPC and creature reference of the rooms of config/room-batches.json, measured from the game data (ROOM-BATCH-NPC-GROUNDING-48; docs/NPC_GROUND_CONTACT.md "Room residents by rule"). Read by tools/actor_grounding.py only for an actor config/actor_grounding.json does not name, by its reference number. floor: the ordinary ground contact; off_floor and no_floor: kept at the authored spot (the third field is its script); authored_dead: its death pose at the authored spot. No positions or heights.
